config.groups: All13 H827/H828 groups unchanged, block and random directions.
config.design: At first downstream block, replace BOTH attention and MLP outputs at final position by recipient native output + signed amplitude times stored H828 central derivative. Factorial: each derivative own versus group mean. Mean is same vector across4 recipients; baseline and skip paths remain recipient-specific.
config.control: Own/own linearized replay vs natural H827 central responses; amp0 own replacements vs native logits.
config.interpretation: Controlled tangent response contribution experiment, not natural mediation: MLP replacement does not adapt to modified attention. Common-both block response alignment is imposed algebraically, downstream propagation remains a test.
config.metric: Cross-recipient cosines for target residual and final uniformly centered/common-reference-weighted logits; common p is group mean native p.
